_note: Every path here is relative to the repository root, so a fresh clone works with no edit. Every script reads this file through scripts/_paths.py. Copy it to config.json to override locally; config.json is gitignored.

knowledge._note: The source directory and the derived index. build_index.py writes the index; freshness_check.py compares the two.

assets._note: The navigation index is parsed for routes; the catalog is the hand-maintained asset inventory. Both feed build_assets_db.py.

gates._note: state_dir holds runtime state files. Those names are the contract; see ARCHITECTURE.md section 4. They are gitignored because they describe what happened in one session, not what the project is.

extra_protected_paths.why: database dumps are unreadable and un-reviewable in a diff
